answer: The echo counter is kept in inlet and vine shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Repeating the trick 18 times costs 27 separate deposits and 12 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
